title: Path-homology excision over arbitrary rings for pushouts along projecting digraph cofibrations
author: Carranza, Daniel; Doherty, Brandon; Kapulkin, Krzysztof; Opie, Morgan; Sarazola, Maru; Wong, Liang Ze
work: Cofibration category of digraphs for path homology

primary_locator.additional_core: full annotated/allowed-path chains, projecting digraph cofibration and pushout definitions and local proofs in Sections2--3 retained

difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an explicit mapping-cone model for relative allowed-path chains using alternating projection grids, then proves its bijectivity through a multistage cancellation induction on paths crossing the subgraph. This is the substantive new excision theorem; the later categorical axioms are not separately harvested as routine consequences.
